ruleDefinitions.name: Local Password Changes Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: This rule detects attempts to change local passwords using 'passwd' or 'echo' commands. This could be indicative of an attacker trying to gain unauthorized access or escalate privileges.

sequences.query: activity_type:"process-create" AND (process_name:"passwd" OR (process_command_line:"echo" AND process_command_line:"| passwd")) AND NOT process_command_line:(" -s "," -S ")
